decisions.decision: Changed CrdtSet::mutex_ from std::mutex to std::recursive_mutex
decisions.rationale: Root cause of the deadlock: PutElems holds mutex_ across its synchronous putHookFunc_ callback, which can re-enter PutElems on the same thread via ConsensusManager certificate-confirmation -> confirmed-tx processing -> ParseRevokeTransaction -> PutKeyLocal -> PutElems again. A plain std::mutex self-deadlocks on that reentry; recursive_mutex allows it. Confirmed via live debugger stack trace (user-provided) plus targeted bracket-logging that showed PutKeyLocal's own Merge call never returning.

decisions.decision: Left PutKeyLocal/PutLocal (the plan's original fix) in place alongside the recursive_mutex fix rather than reverting it
decisions.rationale: PutKeyLocal/PutLocal is still architecturally correct and desirable (avoids unnecessary DAG broadcast for a per-node-derived write) even though it alone did not fix the deadlock; the recursive_mutex change is what actually fixes it. Both together were tested and shown to eliminate the WaitForJob signature across 46 test executions.
